style.css: body { background: #171c1c; color: #dad8cf; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; } p, label { font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; color: #b8bab2; } a { color: #dad8cf; text-decoration: underline; } input[type=checkbox] { width: 16px; height: 16px; accent-color: #9bb180; } button { min-height: 48px; border-radius: 12px; background: #cb704c; color: #171c1c; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; } button:focus-visible, input:focus-visible, a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9bb180; outline-offset: 3px; }
